name: SecWebLab
shortDescription: Web-security training lab with seeded vulnerable samples and fix-oriented findings.
features: Seeded lab samples (insecure + contrasted safe version) for XSS, eval, pickle, shell=True
Findings carry evidence, OWASP-Top-10-style class labels (2021 naming), severity (indicative)
Reproduction steps for local labs only; candidate fixes on every finding
Explicit limitations on every report (passive, not proof, absence != safety)
knownLimitations: Static pattern checks only; deliberately incomplete (no execution/exploitation)
Findings are discussion starting points, not proof of exploitability
